caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" and "Files" icons
- **Center**: Date and time display "Oct 22 21:26"
- **Right Side**: System status icons including network, sound, and power

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Geometric abstract wallpaper with gradient from purple to red
- **Desktop Icon**: Single "Home" folder icon at bottom right corner

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon (command line)
  - Trash icon

## Terminal Window
- **Title Bar**: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Terminal Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~$"
  - Recent commands:
    - `cd ~/Downloads/drm_epub_bundleunprotect-epub ProtectedBook.keylsmktorrent ProtectedBook.epub`
    - Error: "bash: cd: too many arguments"
    - `cd ~/Downloads/drm_epub_bundle`
    - Error: "bash: cd: /home/user/Downloads/drm_epub_bundle: No such file or directory"
    - `mkdir ~/Downloads/drm_epub_bundlecd ~/Downloads`
    - Current prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~$"

## File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**: "Home"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back and Forward navigation arrows
  - Home icon
  - Search icon
  - View options dropdown
  - Menu button
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent" section with clock icon
  - "Starred" section with star icon
  - "Home" section with house icon (currently selected)
  - "Desktop" with folder icon
  - "Documents" with document icon
  - "Downloads" with download icon
  - "Music" with music note icon
  - "Pictures" with image icon
  - "Videos" with video icon
  - "Trash" with trash can icon
  - "Other Locations" with plus icon
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - Visible items:
    - Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Public, requirement.txt
    - server, snap, Templates, Videos
    - .bash_history, .bash_logout, .bashrc
    - .cache, .config, .gnupg, .ipython, .lessht, .local, .mozilla, .var
    - .pki, .profile, .selected_editor, .ssh, .sudo_as_admin_successful, thunderbird
    - .viminfo, .vscode
- **Cursor**: Located near the bottom right of the file manager window
